description: FortiClient Cryptolib.dll Cryptolibrary v3.0 - The Cryptolib library provides the following services for the FortiClient product: RNG, HMAC, SHA1, AES CBC, AES ECB, 3DES. Cryptolib.dll is a user mode application that serves as a wrapper for two other dlls: libeay32.dll and ssleay32.dll.
